$comment: Perk Coin economy for the legendary perk rack's cost line. Every number is quoted from fallout.wiki (fetched 2026-09-28); nothing here is derived from memory. Rank 1 has no price on either page: slotting a legendary perk is gated by the level milestone, so it is modelled as 0 coins and flagged approximate. Perk Coins per level-up are not on the wiki, so the UI shows a cards-scrapped equivalent instead of a level-up count.
rankUpCostSource: https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Perk_Coin: 'Leveling up a perk card costs 50 coins to advance to rank 2, 100 coins to rank 3 and 150 coins to rank 4.' Legendary_perks: 'Ranking up varies at the following prices of 50, 100, and 150 coins for their respective ranks.' Rank 1 is not priced on either page.
scrapSource: https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Perk_Coin: 'Two perk coins are received for scrapping each rank of a perk card. Higher-ranked cards will yield a number of coins corresponding to the card's rank.'
unequipSource: https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Perk_Coin: removing an equipped legendary perk costs 1 coin.
slotUnlockSource: https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Legendary_perks: 'The first legendary slot unlocking at level 50, and new ones at certain level milestones onward at 75, 100, 150, 200, and 300.'
coinsPerLevelUpSource: Not stated on either wiki page; the UI does not show a level-up estimate.
